definitions.gloss: to carry on one's person; to bring along; to have with one
definitions.explanation: To carry something with oneself so that it is readily available. Used for items one keeps on hand, such as phones, identification, or medicine.

examples.japanese: ⟦{常|つね}→常：28958_tsune⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{携帯|けいたい}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I always carry medicine with me.

examples.japanese: ⟦パスポート→パスポート：00341_pasupooto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{海外|かいがい}→海外：00134_kaigai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{義務|ぎむ}→義務：02647_gimu⟧です。
examples.english: Carrying your passport is mandatory when abroad.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{熊|くま}→熊：04343_kuma⟧⟦よけ→よけ：28839_yoke⟧⟦スプレー→スプレー：11581_supuree⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{携帯|けいたい}すること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{推奨|すいしょう}→推奨：12907_suishou⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: In this area, carrying bear spray is recommended.

notes:
A formal verb meaning to carry something on one's person. The noun form ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧ is extremely common as a shortened form of ⟦{携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}→携帯電話：04433_keitaidenwa⟧ (mobile phone), though this usage is increasingly replaced by ⟦スマホ→スマホ：04721_sumaho⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{携帯電話|けいたいでんわ}→携帯電話：04433_keitaidenwa⟧: mobile phone
- ⟦{携帯品|けいたいひん}→携帯品：24930_keitaihin⟧: personal belongings; items carried on one's person
- ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧{食|しょく}: portable food; food to carry
- ⟦{携帯|けいたい}→携帯：00715_keitai⟧⟦{禁止|きんし}→禁止：02643_kinshi⟧: no carrying allowed (e.g., weapons)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{持参|じさん}する→持参する：21143_jisansuru⟧: to bring — focuses on bringing something to a specific place
- ⟦{所持|しょじ}→所持：12751_shoji⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to possess; to have on one's person — more legal/formal, as in possessing weapons or documents
- ⟦{持|も}ち{歩|ある}く→持ち歩く：05739_mochiaruku⟧: to carry around — more casual, implies walking around with something
